summary: Discussion-layer early signals: OpenAI official monitoring note, a multi-vendor GitSpawn security writeup, multiple Bluesky operator field notes about running agents without sandboxes and cost/sandbox latency; several repo-level infra primitives (coop, ripwire, kassette) surfaced via Show HN. | Vendor-only sweep: product launches and infra updates from Anthropic, Cloudflare, Vercel, AWS, Mistral, Daytona, Modal, Supabase, JetBrains, OpenAI and others; notable themes: containment/safety, sandboxes/MCP, managed KB connectors, evals and agent runtimes. | GitHub-first snapshot: mix of high-traction agent platforms (Dify, Vercel, HeyGen), infra primitives for agent runtimes/MCP/memory, and community workflow packages; social/operator reports missing from this shard. | Package-scan: vendor-backed agent tooling (OpenAI, Amazon, Vercel) plus many emerging infra primitives (agent memory, MCP, security scanners). No social/operator reports found in this shard; many single-source packages need corroboration.
